question:
**Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.**

A person who does not believe in God
solution:
The correct answer is: **Atheist**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word '**Atheist**' means a person who does not believe in God or any deity. (नास्तिक)
 
• It is derived from the Greek word '**atheos**', which means '**without gods**'.
 
• The word '**Atheist**' is a **noun **and can be used in a sentence like "*John is an Atheist and does not believe in any religion.*"

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Let us look at the meaning of the other words.

 
• **Iconoclast **means a person who attacks or criticizes traditional beliefs or institutions. (प्रतिमा भंजक)
 
• **Lecher **means a man who has excessive sexual desire or who behaves in a lewd manner. (बदकार)
 
• **Highbrow **means a person who is highly intellectual or cultured. (अभिमानपूर्ण)
